CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aka_agent_campaign_engagement_revision()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- Every write changes the generation, even false -> false, including admin CAS writes.
 IF NEW.key='zalo.campaign_engagement.enabled' THEN
   NEW.updated_at := greatest(clock_timestamp(), COALESCE(OLD.updated_at, '-infinity') + interval '1 microsecond');
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aka_agent_facebook_secret_cleanup()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN DELETE FROM vault.secrets WHERE id=OLD.secret_id; RETURN OLD; END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aka_agent_guard_automation_destination_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE'
    AND NEW.target_campaign_id IS NULL
    AND NEW.target_data_group_id IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(NEW.is_delete, false) = false
  THEN
    NEW.is_active := false;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.chat_zalo_record_conversation_created_event()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.chat_zalo_conversation_event (
    organization_id,
    chat_zalo_conversation_id,
    event_type,
    event_data,
    occurred_at
  ) VALUES (
    NEW.organization_id,
    NEW.id,
    'conversation_created',
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('sourceType', NEW.source_type)),
    NEW.opened_at
  );
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_auto_account_runtime_operation_claim_token()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'đang chạy' THEN
    NEW.runtime_operation_claim_token := NULL;
  ELSIF OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'đang chạy'
    AND NEW.runtime_operation_claim_token IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.runtime_operation_claim_token
  THEN
    -- A different runtime (for example claim_campaign_runtime or an older app)
    -- entered running state without supplying an account-operation token.
    NEW.runtime_operation_claim_token := NULL;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_facebook_login_claim_generation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Runs AFTER the existing BEFORE trigger which clears tokens on pause/reset.
  -- A legacy cleanup or lifecycle recovery must invalidate old FB requests too.
  IF lower(btrim(coalesce(OLD.flatform_type,'')))='facebook'
    AND NEW.runtime_operation_claim_token IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.runtime_operation_claim_token THEN
    NEW.facebook_login_claim_generation:=OLD.facebook_login_claim_generation+1;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.touch_category_catalog_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at := clock_timestamp();
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aka_agent_control_web_device_limit(p_value text, p_active boolean, p_secret boolean)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_active IS TRUE AND p_secret IS FALSE AND btrim(p_value) ~ '^[0-9]{1,10}$'
    AND btrim(p_value)::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647 THEN
    RETURN btrim(p_value)::integer;
  END IF;
  RETURN 3;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aka_agent_data_type_context_present()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT NULLIF(
    current_setting('aka_agent.data_type_category_item_id', true),
    ''
  ) IS NOT NULL;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_enqueue_trial_care_v1(p_customer_id bigint, p_reason text DEFAULT 'purchase_changed'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if p_customer_id is null then return jsonb_build_object('status','skipped'); end if;
 insert into public.aka_app_settings(key,value,updated_at) values('trial_care:pending:'||p_customer_id,
   jsonb_build_object('version',1,'status','pending','customer_id',p_customer_id,'reason',p_reason,'queued_at',clock_timestamp(),'after_id',0,'attempts',0),clock_timestamp())
 on conflict(key) do update set value=excluded.value,updated_at=excluded.updated_at;
 return jsonb_build_object('status','pending','customer_id',p_customer_id);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aka_agent_get_vault_secret(p_name text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'vault'
AS $function$
  SELECT decrypted_secret
  FROM vault.decrypted_secrets
  WHERE name = p_name
  LIMIT 1;
$function$
